option_relations.rationale: The presence of angiofibromas, as indicated by the histologic analysis of the facial papule, is a characteristic feature of Tuberous Sclerosis Complex.
Cutaneous cystinosis is not directly related to the clinical presentation described.
Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome is not directly related to the clinical presentation described.
Cystinosis is not directly related to the clinical presentation described.
